text:
support-jen: Customer report — Python streaming client (SSE) sometimes halts after an auth rotation. They see a 402 billing error immediately before the stream stops. Repro steps below, attaching logs. Need triage, cc @ana_engineer and @mike_eng

support-jen: quick logs:
```
INFO: calling /v1/streams with api_key=redacted
RESPONSE 200 (stream start)
...data chunks...
WARNING: received event fragment: 'data: {"delta": "Hel'
WARNING: keepalive sent
ERROR: 402 Billing: temporary hold
ERROR: SSE parser: unexpected EOF while parsing event
```
support-jen: repro steps (python):
```
from redwood import StreamClient
c = StreamClient(api_key=os.getenv('KEY'))
for chunk in c.stream('...'):
    # generator yields until hang
    print(chunk)
```
support-jen: Customer says they run into this after their internal KMS rotated keys (we rotate tokens every 6h). Happens ~1-3% of streams.

ana_engineer: looking. which sdk version? any proxy in front?

support-jen: they sent version: redwood-sdk==0.9.1, python 3.10. No external proxy, direct from GKE -> us-west.

mike_eng: raising red flag: 0.9.1 predates the auth-rotation retry fixes. Can you confirm whether they see partial token (fragmented json) like above?

support-jen: yes — the first partial token 'Hel' then EOF. Also saw an HTTP 402 before the EOF in same connection.

ana_engineer: hypothesis: billing 402 triggers server-side short-circuit that sends a truncated SSE event while we rotate auth, then client generator blocks waiting for event delimiter. Newer client has a keepalive/heartbeat parser that treats incomplete event as flushable.

sre_tom: fwiw we had a brief spike in token validation errors last night (auth-service logs show ~0.4% 401/402 bursts for 30min in us-west). Could correlate.

mike_eng: can you ask customer to try 1) latest sdk (1.2.0) 2) set STREAM_READ_TIMEOUT env to 90s 3) enable debug logs? If repro, capture raw bytes (tcpdump) so we can see if server cut connection mid-event.

support-jen: will ask. sending quick workaround in the meantime: wrap generator with timeout to break on hang. Example:
```
import signal

class TimeoutError(Exception): pass

def handler(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError()

signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, handler)
signal.alarm(60)  # 60s
try:
    for chunk in c.stream('...'):
        print(chunk)
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
```
support-jen: customer said they can test tomorrow morning. They also asked whether billing 402 should abort streams — they expect it to return a clear final event rather than truncating.

ana_engineer: agreed — server should emit a final `event: error` with payload before closing. I'll follow up with runtime to see if truncation happened during auth fallback.

deploy-bot: [deployment] rolled out auth-service patch v1.4.2 -> us-west at 02:12 UTC (no downtime) :rocket:

billing-bot: noted a billing policy change rollout yesterday; some accounts temporarily hit new threshold checks. Filing ticket BILL-431.

mike_eng: action items: 1) ask customer to upgrade SDK -> 1.2.0 and enable debug logs 2) if still repro, capture raw tcp bytes (pcap) and attach 3) SRE to correlate auth spikes -> @sre_tom 4) Runtime team to ensure we emit final error event on billing aborts.

support-jen: added steps to case and asked customer to test. thanks all :thumbsup:
